name: Hazard: Magical Girdle
source:
It is the adventure story about smart pothunter Odysseus Schliemann who can't miss a pretty girl and constantly gets in trouble because of that. In the first chapter you will receive a task to find the Magical Girdle of Hippolyte – the Amazon Queen. 

[From [url=https://kexboy.itch.io/hazard-magical-girdle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是关于聪明的猎人奥德修斯·施利曼的冒险故事，他不会放过漂亮的女孩，并因此不断陷入麻烦。在第一章中，你将收到寻找亚马逊女王希波吕忒的魔法腰带的任务。

[来自[url=https://kexboy.itch.io/hazard-magical-girdle]Itch.io[/url]]
